quote: The game is just full of bugs and glichtes, is way more restrictive than GTA V and the plot is sooo boring. Jason has zero personality! The duo concept coud have bring so much gameplaywise... such a shame

author: Riverage
quote: An extremely well-done remake. It's very faithful, yet it feels like a fresh new journey thanks to the stunning visuals. Link's controls are so smooth! They've added so much life to Hyrule, giving every NPC a proper personality and unique traits... and the new arrangements are amazing!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
